File paths are used when linking to external files, like: An absolute file path is the full URL to a file: A relative file path points to a file relative to the current page. In the following example, the file path points to a file in the images folder located at the root of the current website: In the following example, the file path points to a file in the images folder located in the current folder: In the following example, the file path points to a file in the images folder located in the folder one level up from the current folder: It is best practice to use relative file paths (if possible). When using relative file paths, your web pages will not be bound to your current base URL.
